data.gist: Fixed knees were micro-CT scanned at 10 µm to quantify 3D subchondral bone microarchitecture of medial and lateral proximal tibia using standardized thresholds and ASBMR nomenclature.
data.plain: After harvest and fixation, knees were imaged by high-resolution X-ray micro-CT. Regions just beneath the joint cartilage in the upper shin bone were outlined and bone volume, density and other structural measures were computed automatically using standard settings and accepted naming conventions.
